AI_ICP optimizes the swap sequence so that two or more units do not leave work at the same time. When the PHM module of AI_ICP detects an anomaly sign in the pressure pattern of the hydraulic system of U-EDT Unit 7, the maintenance team, on this basis, performs preventive maintenance on the hydraulic module of U-EDT Unit 7 within 1 h.
